description: This Java source file contains JUnit test cases for the OpenMRS project, specifically testing the behavior of the '@SkipBaseSetup' annotation in the context of user authentication and dataset initialization.

classes.name: OpenmrsTestAnnotationsTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for verifying the behavior of the '@SkipBaseSetup' annotation during authentication and data setup in OpenMRS.

methods.name: shouldCallBaseSetupMethod
methods.description: Tests that the '@Before' setup in the base test class authenticates the user and loads initial data, and then logs out for subsequent tests.

methods.name: shouldSkipAuthentication
methods.description: Tests that when '@SkipBaseSetup' annotation is used, the user is not authenticated and no dataset is loaded.
